CrowCode bundled command-line tools (Linux and Windows x86_64)

These unmodified upstream executables are compressed with gzip and embedded in
the platform-specific CrowCode executable. No upstream shell integrations,
completions, or standalone installers are included.

Source: https://github.com/BurntSushi/ripgrep/tree/15.2.0
Release: https://github.com/BurntSushi/ripgrep/releases/tag/15.2.0
Upstream is dual-licensed under MIT or Unlicense; distributed here under MIT.
